description: This file contains JavaScript code for rendering BigPipe placeholders using Drupal's Ajax system, including functions for processing AJAX responses, handling DOM mutations, and initializing mutation observers.

methods.name: mapTextContentToAjaxResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON content from a script tag to an AJAX response or returns false if invalid or empty.

methods.name: processReplacement
methods.description: Executes AJAX commands in a script tag, replacing placeholders with HTML and loading resources.

methods.name: checkMutation
methods.description: Checks if a DOM node is a valid BigPipe placeholder script element.

methods.name: checkMutationAndProcess
methods.description: Checks if a node is a valid placeholder and processes it; also checks parent nodes if necessary.

methods.name: processMutations
methods.description: Handles DOM mutations, processing added nodes and specific character data changes.
